hits.about: Aura is a picturesque complex in the Jebel Ali area, artfully integrated into the dynamic landscape of Dubai. On the 18 floors of this magnificent building, there are modern studios and apartments with 1 or 2 bedrooms, offering the perfect combination of comfort and style.The Aura exterior is inspired by a modern architectural trend reflecting understated elegance and functionality.The apartments offer spacious layouts where everyone will find their place. The interiors are decorated in soothing tones using high-quality finishing materials, and central air conditioning maintains a comfortable atmosphere at any time of the year.Aura residents can enjoy a wide range of amenities, including a gym, swimming pool, spa, as well as the availability of cafes, restaurants and retail space right on the ground floors of the building. There is a metro station nearby, providing easy access to other parts of the city, and proximity to key highways makes moving around Dubai easy and convenient.Jebel Ali is an area with incredible infrastructure and development prospects, with Al Maktoum International Airport and Palm Jebel Ali in close proximity. Surrounded by this area, you can enjoy the beauty of sandy beaches and numerous entertainment options. Sheikh Zayed Road provides quick access to the city's main attractions, reducing travel time to Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai to a minimum.
